description: A painting in dark, oil-like brushwork. Center-left, a backlit chest X-ray on a light box shows the ribcage, spine and a thin pale line curving down through the chest. Two dark silhouetted hands hold the edges of the film. In the foreground a stainless steel tray holds a coiled red-brown tube, with a syringe, small glass vials and forceps on the table beside it. Only the dim edge of the light box and the film's dark rim appear, with no text or signature visible.
